name: @ozjsey/v-keyboard-navigation
description: Vue 3 directive that turns a group of controls into one tab stop — roving tabindex, arrow keys, typeahead, Home/End, real PageUp/PageDown — with the controlled scroll (focus preventScroll + block:'nearest') the browser's own focus scroll gets wrong
author: Ozgur Seyidoglu

scripts.build: tsup vKeyboardNavigation.ts --format esm --minify --sourcemap --dts --out-dir dist --clean && mv dist/vKeyboardNavigation.js dist/vKeyboardNavigation.min.js && mv dist/vKeyboardNavigation.js.map dist/vKeyboardNavigation.min.js.map && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/vKeyboardNavigation.min.js';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace('//# sourceMappingURL=vKeyboardNavigation.js.map','//# sourceMappingURL=vKeyboardNavigation.min.js.map');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);"
